title: Differential merge into an existing mod
description: Three-way compare across 5 entity types (characters, events, decisions, focus nodes, ideas). Detects field-level conflicts automatically; choose which side to keep for each. Cosmetic tag names and map/interface colors stay as they are in the base mod. To include your project’s changes to them, use full export or append export.
folderPickerHint: Open the folder that holds the mod's descriptor.mod, such as a Steam Workshop item under steamapps\workshop\content\394360 or a mod in your mod folder. The program only reads it and never changes it.
folderNotAMod: This folder is not a Hearts of Iron IV mod: it has no descriptor.mod with a mod name. Choose the folder that holds descriptor.mod.
